structures:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for a small portrait Chinese village tower defense game. Create exactly 16 separate modular architectural component sprites arranged in a precise uniform 4 columns x 4 rows grid on a transparent square canvas. Each cell has generous transparent margin; sprites must NOT touch between cells. No labels, no characters, no text, no grid lines. Charming finely outlined low-resolution pixel game art, warm brown outlines, ochre timber, cream plaster, blue-gray stone, terracotta. View: near-front orthographic with a SMALL visible top plane, not isometric diamonds. These are COMPONENTS, not whole buildings. Lighting upper left. Flat bottoms and straight vertical sides so parts stack without gaps.
Row1 left to right: (1) low wide rectangular rough stone foundation slab, (2) low wide wooden floor/platform with thick edge, (3) rectangular cream plaster half-timber wall panel with NO roof and NO window, (4) rectangular gray stone wall panel with NO roof and NO door.
Row2: (1) flat-topped tall timber lattice tower storey, exactly two strong vertical posts and X bracing, transparent between posts, NO roof, (2) wide golden straw gable roof ONLY, (3) wide warm red tiled gable roof ONLY, (4) wide blue-gray tiled hip roof ONLY.
Row3: (1) ornate gold-edged dark teal pavilion roof ONLY, (2) small wooden arched door with deep brown opening, (3) small square cream-framed wood lattice window, (4) wide fortified gray stone parapet/platform with three crenellations and visible floor, NO tower below.
Row4: (1) wide wooden open entrance arch with double wooden gate doors, NO roof, (2) stout gray stone gate arch with open dark passage and stone jambs, NO roof, (3) short wide wooden front balcony railing, (4) a short broad terracotta awning on two short wooden posts for a porch, NO building walls.
Consistent crisp thick dark-brown pixel outlines, clean simple silhouettes readable at 32-80 pixels, restrained highlights, no soft shadows outside sprites, no ground shadows, no vegetation, no decorations beyond the requested components. Transparent alpha background. Exactly one component centered per grid cell.
